assessments.name: Structured Oral Examination (for DENT 6399)
assessments.description:
Structured Oral Examination (for DENT 6399)
1 hour offered for reading of questions and structuring answers. 1 hour for answering of questions. Questions mostly but not limited to Fixed and Removable Prosthodontics.

assessments.name: Seminar participation, submission and presentation (For DENT 6399)
assessments.description: Seminar  preparation, submission and  presentation. All literature reviews need to be submitted to the Course Director and / Supervisor AT LEAST 7 days in advance of presentation. Active participation is expected in all seminars.

assessments.name: Portfolio of Seminars and Presentations
assessments.description: Report on all written work including seminars and study groups and presentations as well as any auxillary work done, conference attendance and presentations. Does NOT include case reports and presentations.
